# Adversarial inputs aimed at each rule in src/kernel/json/document.hpp: every
# single byte, alone, inside a string, and after a backslash; pairs of grammar
# characters; the number grammar crossed with signs, fractions, and exponents;
# \u escapes and surrogate pairs at every boundary; UTF-8 lead bytes against
# second-byte boundaries; duplicate keys and key order; whitespace, structure,
# and nesting to either side of max_depth. Format: README.md.
